notes.title: Big Update | Patch Note 0.1.8
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=G93HB3F-Ezk;full][/previewyoutube]

- Added aiming mode (holding RMB), allows you to rotate the character towards the mouse while running and attack
without hovering the mouse over the enemy.
- Dash is now performed by double clicking on the right mouse button.
- Added animations for running sideways, backwards, diagonally, etc. for each type of weapon animation in aiming mode.
- Added tooltip for inventory management
- Added background transparency to the character menu
- Now the "ESC" button pauses the game.
- Increased arrow flight speed
- Arrows no longer get stuck in doorways
- Small redesign of the dialog box
- Added animations for two-handed weapons
- Adjusted the size of two-handed weapons
- Added a new craft item "Booster" (Restores all the player's parmaters by 150 units, health, mana, dash)
- Removed Dash's recovery banks.
- Added a new item "Antidote" (removes negative effects)
- Added a new item "Energy Shield".
- Revorking the damage resistance system. Added an UI element to display negative and positive effects on the player.
- Enemies' health and effects are now displayed above their heads, except for mini-bosses. Their health is displayed separately on the player's screen.
- New types of enemies:
     - Poisonous scorpion. Inflicts a negative poisoning effect on the player. Has immunity from poisoning.
     - Skeleton with a shield. Physical damage taken slightly less.
     - Fiery skeleton with a shield. Deals fire damage and a fire effect on the player. Resistant to fire.
     - Ice beetle. Inflicts a cold effect on the player. Has resistance to cold.
     - Fiery skeleton mage. Deals fire damage and applies a fire effect to the player. Resistant to all effects.

- Added new weapons:
     - Crossbow
     - Flame Simple Bow
     - Icy Simple Bow
     - Poisonous Simple Bow

notes.title: General changelog (October 15th) and list for future patches
notes.content:
[b] Hello everyone, friends! [/ b]
Over the past week, a lot of work has been done on the bugs. Thanks to all those who support me and report problems with the game. I try to respond quickly to your comments.

[u] Today I would like to summarize the first set of updates and show the list for the next patches! [/ u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39255012/7b7e68399671d8889b2fa49b60cea01cf668b7d0.jpg[/img]

List of patches and changes that have already been released:

[b] Patch 0.1.5: [/ b]
- Added mini-map. Now, after passing the first training location, the mini-map is activated.
It displays the main quests, secondary quests, exit to the village and chests.
- Fixed a bug when the character stopped attacking.
- Changed damage resistance interface, now icons are displayed instead of text.
- Fixed a bug with incorrect display of the current skill level, when the description indicated the basic characteristics, and not those for which the player was pumped.
- Fixed a bug with the display of the skill description window, before the game displayed a small white window with a description and a large correct one. Now only the correct one is shown.
- Fixed a bug when the healing skill stopped working

[b] Patch 0.1.4: [/ b]
- Fixed game crash when firing ranged weapons.
- Now arrows and bullets do not fly to the floor or ceiling

[b] Patch 0.1.3: [/ b]
- Removed delay in character actions. Items are now picked up quickly, and the character does not wait half a second before strikes.
- The method of interacting with the environment has been completely rewritten, earlier on weaker PCs there was a problem of interacting with the environment.
Now the character will use environmental items under any circumstances. Levers, doors, dialogs and more
- Changed the color of damage units from enemies from yellow to white.
- Now the player's mana is restored automatically, but very slowly, about 0.3% per second.

[b] Patch 0.1.2: [/ b]
- Added V-sync setting
- Fixed the problem of starting the game in VR mode Steam
- Adjusted graphics settings
- Debris from barrels is no longer an obstacle to picking up items.
- Added an explanation from whom to buy apples in the description of the quest of the old hunter.
- The night church has been slightly optimized.

[b] Patch 0.1.1: [/ b]
- Now the player's camera moves more smoothly, gradually moving behind the player.
- After death, monsters are ignored to attack. Killed monsters no longer interfere with mouse hover.
- A little more optimization on the first location
- In the first dungeon, obstructing walls have been removed
- The character no longer becomes invisible when performing a dash
- Graphics settings now work correctly. The image is not pixelated.
- Now graphics can be customized directly during the game. Not only in the main menu.
- Now cocoons of small spiders are not activated when approached a second time if they are smashed in the distance.
- Fixed the color balance of the village in the second stage (after the fire)
- In the sewers, the puzzle with the valves was removed and the hole in the location was closed, where it was possible to fall through the map.
- In the mines, the place where it was possible to get out of the location was closed and an interactive object that was mistakenly included in the previous version of the game was removed.
- Fixed a bug in the name of the Anti-Aliasing setting
- Reduced character image in inventory menu
- The pumping of health, mana and dash is now saved correctly. There was a problem where the health points gained did not persist between levels.
- In the first location, the horse no longer gets stuck in place
- Added FPS lock option at 30,60,120,240

List of future fixes and patches:
- Adding screen resolution settings, automatic detection of monitor parameters
- Bug fix when character refuses to walk stairs on WASD
- Adding control settings
- Adding sound settings
- Redesign of the interface
- Recycling of the crafting system
- Rework of the STR / AGE / INTELLIGENCE system
- Rework of some areas of locations

notes.title: Changelog for a future patch
notes.content:
Found the causes of some problems on weak PCs.  When the character refused to interact with the environment and enemies.  This and a few other things were suggested to me by the guys who already bought the game.
 A sample list of fixes that I will start working on shortly:

 1. I will remove the dependence of the player's interaction on the FPS.  (Now for those who have less than 30 fps, interactive objects and strikes simply do not work)

 2. I will check the save parameters, because it turned out that the parameters of health and mana after pumping are not saved between levels.  (But the person was able to complete the game with this problem, hello to you)

 3. Add control settings and keyboard key assignments to options.

 4. Add sound volume settings.

 5. I will close several holes in the locations where you could climb (again, hello to the one who found this)

 6. I will remove the delay between pressing the button and the action of the character.  It has been noticed that there is a slight lag before a hit or other action.
